comparison: Perfect agreement on cell size measurements (C25-C28). Both evaluations accept these literature-derived values as established parameters without challenge.

Both address the scRNA-seq discrepancy (C41-C42). OpenEval rates as UNCERTAIN due to speculative explanations without validation; peer reviewers SUPPORT it as reasonable speculation addressing known technical limitations.
Perfect agreement on two-nest simulation results (C67-C71). Both evaluations support the coalescence dynamics and anisotropic shape observations as valid model outputs.

Strong agreement on spatial model results (C31, C34-C35, C37-C38, C63-C64). Both support the dual role of CAFs in limiting tumor expansion while excluding T-cells. Peer review also includes C53 which OpenEval addresses separately in R13.

Strong agreement on experimental patient sample data (C20-C21, C23-C24, C43, C50). Both evaluations accept the immunohistochemistry findings without challenge. OpenEval also includes C22 which peer review addresses in R1.

Divergent evaluations on modeling framework assumptions (C45, C57, C59, C62, C76-C77). OpenEval rates SUPPORTED with clear articulation; peer reviewers rate UNCERTAIN, expressing concerns about close-to-equilibrium assumptions while acknowledging justification provided. OpenEval also includes C44, C51-C52 which peer review addresses in R4.

Agreement on CAF biology background (C6-C15, C46-C49, C54-C56). Both support these extensively cited claims as established context. Peer review R1 is broader, also covering epidemiology, T-cell biology, and other background claims.

Agreement on dynamical system analysis conclusions (C29, C39-C40). Both support the identification of two controlling mechanisms. Peer review R4 also includes modeling framework claims (C44, C51-C52) that OpenEval addresses in R8.

Divergent evaluations on ECM orientation effects (C74-C75). OpenEval rates SUPPORTED based on simulation results; peer reviewers rate UNCERTAIN, noting this aspect remains exploratory despite being addressed. OpenEval also includes C30, C72-C73 which peer review addresses in R1.
Agreement on translational implications (C80). Both support the proposed clinical utility for enhancing immunotherapy efficacy. OpenEval also includes C78-C79 which peer review addresses in R1.
Agreement on epidemiological background (C1-C3). Both accept these as well-established facts. Peer review R1 is much broader, encompassing multiple background claim categories.
Agreement on tumor-stroma interaction motivation (C4-C5). Both support these cited claims as appropriate context. Peer review R1 covers this within a larger set of background claims.
Agreement on T-cell biology background (C16-C19). Both accept these cited claims as established context. Peer review R1 includes this within comprehensive background coverage.
Agreement on overall spatial modeling conclusion (C53). Both support the dual role summary. OpenEval treats this as a separate conclusion; peer review includes it with detailed spatial model results.
